voice_check.all: Everything: it only listens to known voices

phrases: It's a lovely day to go for a walk in the park.
Set an alarm for half past seven tomorrow morning, please.
Remind me that I have to call my mother this afternoon.
What's on my calendar for the weekend?
Send a message to the kitchen saying that dinner is ready.

speech.voice_name: Let's learn your voice. What's your name?
speech.voice_start: Hi, {name}. I'll ask you for {count} sentences; say them in your usual voice.
speech.voice_again: A bit longer: say the whole sentence again.
speech.voice_learnt: Done, {name}: now I know your voice.
speech.voice_refused: I don't recognise your voice: I won't do that.

options.voice_check: Once a voice has been learnt.
options.voice_adapt: From what each person says. It only keeps voice prints, never the audio; turning it off deletes what was learnt this way.
